claims: The 2026 Oscars is the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony is scheduled to last approximately three to three and a half hours.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony is scheduled to run from 7 p.m. to around 10:30 p.m. ET on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony start time is 4 p.m. PT.
Conan O'Brien is the host of the 2026 Oscars.
The 2026 Oscars location is Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
The broadcasters for the 2026 Oscars are ABC and Hulu.
The 2026 Oscars includes the new Best Casting award.
